name: Sandodden
description:
Sandodden [425-1] is a former trappers' station, located at Daneborg in Young Sund on Wollaston Forland. Sandodden is well suited as temporary base camp for 3-6 persons. Since 1991 Sandodden including Skindskuret and Sorte Skur is serving as NANOK's base camp in the Daneborg region. Sandodden was renovated by Nanok in 2020.

Utilization program:

  • Every year: Mid July - Mid september: NANOK

If you want to stay at Sandodden:

In order to use and stay at Sandodden users must have a written agreement with Nanok. There will be a fee, which is used by Nanok to keep Sandodden in good condition. The fee is:

  • Scientific expeditions: Start fee DKK 1,000.00 per person, thereafter DKK 350.00 per person per day.
  • Other expeditions. Start fee DKK 3,000.00 per person, thereafter DKK 1,000.00 per person per day.

In case anyone want to use Sandodden for accomodation, then they must bring along all food, provisions, and equipment for own use; and remove everything before departure at the end of stay.

Before leaving the house must always be left only in a good condition, meaning:

  • All doors and windows / shutters securely closed
  • Electricity turned off
  • House nicely swept and cleaned all over
  • No food or garbage left behind
  • No equipment or provisions left behind in Sandodden, Skindskuret or Sorte Skur. Such equipment og provisions will be removed by NANOK without prior notice, and at the owners expense.

Contact Nanok (e-mail: nanok@xsirius.dk) for further information.  

Aage V. Jensens Fonde sponsor Nanok's work.

Number in brackets [ ] refer to hut number in Peter Schmidt Mikkelsen: "North-East Greenland 1908-60. The Trapper Era"  (2008) published by Scott Polar Research Institute.
